scope: execution reproducibility and global-index semantics only

discovery.issue: The A1 restart checkpoints record the independent-solver contract and contiguous global-index coverage, but the local scalar execution source and the exact global-index-to-parameter decoder were not committed. The files are represented only by local artifact hashes. A later clean-room reconstruction reproduces multiple published aggregate scalar metrics within a few thousandths of a degree C but does not reproduce every 90 C first-crossing classification at threshold-edge cases. Therefore the 2K checkpoint cannot serve as a fully reproducible resume anchor.
discovery.affected_claim: exact authoritative continuation from global index 2000
discovery.interpretation: This is a reproducibility defect in the local execution harness, not evidence for or against M2 physics.

historical_checkpoint_disposition.reason: Exact threshold-edge classification cannot be independently regenerated from committed source.

grid_order.ordering_rule: Cartesian product in the listed order with the last field varying fastest. global_index = structural_index * 243 + control_index.

new_authoritative_execution_contract.per_configuration_solver: one independent scipy.solve_ivp RK45 integration of the four-state M2 system
new_authoritative_execution_contract.engine_heat_profile: compute direct_fuel_energy_rate_w * wall_heat_fraction at source samples, then linearly interpolate the resulting engine-heat profile
new_authoritative_execution_contract.compiled_rhs_rule: Compilation may accelerate arithmetic only. SciPy solve_ivp remains the integrator. The compiled path must be spot-checked against the committed Python/reference path before any checkpoint is promoted.
